t4_side.finding: T5 p_duplicate is constant across all 20 T4 candidates within each ticket; therefore it cannot change native T4 candidate ordering.

overall_conclusion: T4/T5 evidence interaction is observable, but the investigation does not establish a robust native decision-fusion benefit. T4-side candidate reranking is structurally unsupported by the ticket-level T5 evidence representation. T5-side evidence addition produces mixed evaluation behavior and therefore does not justify claiming general fusion improvement.
